rows.summary: Indian Railways is reportedly evaluating the removal of the Reservation Against Cancellation ticket system. Introduced during the era of manual railway reservations, the system may no longer be necessary due to real-time electronic tracking of cancellations and vacant berths. For Indian rail passengers, this potential policy shift could mean the end of shared berths and changes to how waitlisted tickets are cleared.
rows.why_it_matters: No more shared train berths if RAC is scrapped.
